_doc: SIMCODE v2 example models (m1809, g13; network weights: python -m simcode.download_models; read through simcode.config.model_set(name), which also takes the path of a model folder with a model.json). File names are relative to the models directory. One model = detector + emitter network of pass 1 (detector, emitter), of pass 2 (detector_pass2, emitter_pass2), their solve calibrations and the selection-aware sigma rescale. cal_sim / cal_sim_pass2 = the solve calibrations of pass 1 / pass 2 (prior_off from simulated gate scenes rendered with the model's PSF, the fixed c; no sigma factors: the emitter networks' joint prior / intensity covariance), used for simulated and real movies alike (nothing in them is measured on real data); sig_u = sigma rescale per pass (table.build_table sig_u), pass 1 then pass 2. All models are PSF-matched: trained on one averaged in-situ PSF (psf).

_production._doc: How the paper's SIMCODE v2 tables are made: python -m simcode.run --dataset <name> --data-root <dir> (= --movie under --data-root, --calib, --model and --crop of the entry, and the run.py defaults: pass 2, the model's sigma rescale). The tables are locs_p1.hdf5 / locs_p2.hdf5; the paper's selection (max(sigma_x, sigma_y) <= 12 nm on the rows with p >= 0.63 inside the crop) is applied at load: simcode.dataset.Dataset.select. Movies are relative to the data root given with --data-root.
_production._selection_doc: main selection: rows with p >= 0.63 inside the crop and calibrated max(sigma_x, sigma_y) <= 12 nm (simcode.table.select, Dataset.select, SIGMA_MAX_NM), applied when a table is loaded.
_production._datasets_doc: This repository ships the example models m1809 (in-situ PSF of the 1809/2 movie) and g13 (Gaussian PSF, sigma 1.3 px); the paper branch also has m25 (2.5 nM / 2 and 20 nM / 2 movies) and their datasets.

m1809._doc: PSF-matched model for the 1809/2 movie (trained on its averaged in-situ PSF + camera calibration v2, m1809/calib_1809_2_psf_v2.psf.zip; 3D head with z output; generic pass 2: accepts any measured two-orientation pattern); also the model of the realistic-PSF paper simulations

g13._doc: PSF-matched model for the Gaussian sigma 1.3 px PSF (the preprint-condition simulations; m1809 recipe + --dens 0.0005,0.06, --tau 3,80; 3D head with z output; generic pass 2)
